title: Hogwarts Legacy
provenance: Reported working by WaterWANG-1014 (highball-db#48, 2026-09-15), Apple M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7, Highball 0.9.19 with the corrected DirectX 12 shim, D3DMetal, launches and runs. Not verified by the maintainer. Also reported by amoslanz44 (highball-db#80, 2026-09-16), Apple M5, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, D3DMetal, Epic copy, rated 5 of 5 after 7 minutes. Reported again by c2p-cmd (highball-db#138, 2026-09-19), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.28, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 (playable, minor issues) after 9 minutes, having installed the Visual C++ runtimes first.
notes: DirectX 12 only, so D3DMetal. Before Highball 0.9.19 it stopped at "Failed to initialize DirectX 12" on every Mac: the timestamp shim in front of D3DMetal's d3d12.dll numbered its exports from 1 and the game asks for D3D12CreateDevice by ordinal 101, so it never got a device (highball-db#48, the same bug as Path of Exile 2). Fixed in the engines shipped with 0.9.19 (r3 and r9). Do not add -dx11, the game refuses two graphics API flags and crashes at start. The recipe still advertises AVX to the game, it was on in the working run and whether it is needed is not known. A second report on an M5 with macOS 26 rates it perfect on D3DMetal, Epic copy. A third report on an M3 Pro, macOS 27.0, engine r5, rated it playable with minor issues after installing the Visual C++ runtimes; the unspecified minor issues are not recorded here. The same reporter noted the first launch failed and the second launched fine, and that the minor issues were the game's own default graphics choices and a game dialog you click OK on, not Highball.

knownIssues.symptom: "Failed to initialize DirectX 12" a few seconds after launch on D3DMetal, no crash, no log (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: measured: the DirectX 12 timestamp shim exported its functions numbered from 1 and the game binds D3D12CreateDevice by ordinal 101
knownIssues.fix: Highball 0.9.19 and its engines r3 and r9. Confirmed by the reporter

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at second zero at fixed addresses when -dx11 is among the Steam launch options
knownIssues.cause: measured from the crash context: the game adds its own DirectX 12 flag and Unreal refuses two graphics API flags

knownIssues.symptom: Start fails until the Microsoft Visual C++ runtimes are installed (reported on an M3 Pro, macOS 27.0)
knownIssues.cause: not measured here; the game's prerequisite runtimes were missing from the prefix
knownIssues.fix: Install the Visual C++ runtimes into the environment, then launch (the reporter's step)
